designers.description: Pocketknife is led by Jared Gibbons, a seasoned Squarespace designer and founder with more than a decade of experience building custom websites for service businesses, creatives, and growing brands across the U.S. The studio creates fast, mobile-friendly sites designed around SEO, clear messaging, and conversion.
